parameters.query:
SELECT

    /* =========================
       OVERALL KPIs
       ========================= */

    COUNT(*) AS total_bookings,

    ROUND(SUM(FINAL_REVENUE), 2) AS total_revenue,

    ROUND(AVG(ADR), 2) AS average_adr,

    ROUND(
        SUM(BOOKING_STATUS = 'cancelled') * 100.0 / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS cancellation_rate,


    /* =========================
       HOTEL PERFORMANCE
       ========================= */

    SUM(HOTEL = 'City Hotel') AS city_bookings,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN HOTEL = 'City Hotel' THEN FINAL_REVENUE
            ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS city_revenue,

    ROUND(
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN HOTEL = 'City Hotel' THEN ADR
        END), 2
    ) AS city_average_adr,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN HOTEL = 'City Hotel'
            AND BOOKING_STATUS = 'cancelled'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) * 100.0
        / SUM(HOTEL = 'City Hotel'),
        2
    ) AS city_cancellation_rate,


    SUM(HOTEL = 'Resort Hotel') AS resort_bookings,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN HOTEL = 'Resort Hotel' THEN FINAL_REVENUE
            ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS resort_revenue,

    ROUND(
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN HOTEL = 'Resort Hotel' THEN ADR
        END), 2
    ) AS resort_average_adr,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN HOTEL = 'Resort Hotel'
            AND BOOKING_STATUS = 'cancelled'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) * 100.0
        / SUM(HOTEL = 'Resort Hotel'),
        2
    ) AS resort_cancellation_rate,


    /* =========================
       CUSTOMER SEGMENT
       ========================= */

    SUM(CUSTOMER_SEGMENT = 'Business') AS business_bookings,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN CUSTOMER_SEGMENT = 'Business'
            THEN FINAL_REVENUE ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS business_revenue,

    SUM(CUSTOMER_SEGMENT = 'Individual') AS individual_bookings,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN CUSTOMER_SEGMENT = 'Individual'
            THEN FINAL_REVENUE ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS individual_revenue,

    SUM(CUSTOMER_SEGMENT = 'Group') AS group_bookings,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN CUSTOMER_SEGMENT = 'Group'
            THEN FINAL_REVENUE ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS group_revenue,


    /* =========================
       BOOKING PLATFORM
       ========================= */

    SUM(BOOKING_PLATFORM = 'Mobile App') AS mobile_app_bookings,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN BOOKING_PLATFORM = 'Mobile App'
            THEN FINAL_REVENUE ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS mobile_app_revenue,

    SUM(BOOKING_PLATFORM = 'Website') AS website_bookings,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN BOOKING_PLATFORM = 'Website'
            THEN FINAL_REVENUE ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS website_revenue,

    SUM(BOOKING_PLATFORM = 'Partner Platform') AS partner_platform_bookings,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN BOOKING_PLATFORM = 'Partner Platform'
            THEN FINAL_REVENUE ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS partner_platform_revenue,


    /* =========================
       LEAD TIME CANCELLATION
       ========================= */

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN LEAD_TIME BETWEEN 0 AND 7
            AND BOOKING_STATUS = 'cancelled'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) * 100.0
        / SUM(LEAD_TIME BETWEEN 0 AND 7),
        2
    ) AS cancellation_0_7_days,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN LEAD_TIME BETWEEN 8 AND 30
            AND BOOKING_STATUS = 'cancelled'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) * 100.0
        / SUM(LEAD_TIME BETWEEN 8 AND 30),
        2
    ) AS cancellation_8_30_days,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN LEAD_TIME BETWEEN 31 AND 90
            AND BOOKING_STATUS = 'cancelled'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) * 100.0
        / SUM(LEAD_TIME BETWEEN 31 AND 90),
        2
    ) AS cancellation_31_90_days,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN LEAD_TIME BETWEEN 91 AND 180
            AND BOOKING_STATUS = 'cancelled'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) * 100.0
        / SUM(LEAD_TIME BETWEEN 91 AND 180),
        2
    ) AS cancellation_91_180_days,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN LEAD_TIME > 180
            AND BOOKING_STATUS = 'cancelled'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) * 100.0
        / SUM(LEAD_TIME > 180),
        2
    ) AS cancellation_180_plus_days,


    /* =========================
       REPEAT GUEST
       ========================= */

    SUM(IS_REPEATED_GUEST = 1) AS repeat_guest_bookings,

    SUM(IS_REPEATED_GUEST = 0) AS new_guest_bookings,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN IS_REPEATED_GUEST = 1
            AND BOOKING_STATUS = 'cancelled'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) * 100.0
        / SUM(IS_REPEATED_GUEST = 1),
        2
    ) AS repeat_guest_cancellation_rate,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN IS_REPEATED_GUEST = 0
            AND BOOKING_STATUS = 'cancelled'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) * 100.0
        / SUM(IS_REPEATED_GUEST = 0),
        2
    ) AS new_guest_cancellation_rate,


    /* =========================
       DISCOUNT IMPACT
       ========================= */

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE = 0
            THEN FINAL_REVENUE ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS revenue_0_discount,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE = 5
            THEN FINAL_REVENUE ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS revenue_5_discount,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE = 10
            THEN FINAL_REVENUE ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS revenue_10_discount,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE = 15
            THEN FINAL_REVENUE ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS revenue_15_discount,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE = 20
            THEN FINAL_REVENUE ELSE 0
        END), 2
    ) AS revenue_20_discount

FROM hospitality_revenue_sql;
